audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Levels 2-3 to Ambessa and Levels 4-5 to neither side, which inverts the page's own whys: the whys call Level 2 an even skirmish and Levels 4-5 Aurora's single best window.
audit.why: whys[1] says "Even skirmish... neither side wins the exchange yet"; whys[3] says "your Q cooldown, passive healing, and Across the Veil all line up — you out-poke and out-space her in the only window before ultimates swing it". Level 3 is where Lacerate (13/12/11/10/9) plus Drakehound's Step lets her weave onto you, and from 6 onward Public Execution (130/115/100, 1250 range) owns every all-in. 48.81% over 84 games fits an Ambessa-sided back half with one real Aurora window at 4-5.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Aurora / Skill / Ambessa / Aurora / Ambessa / Ambessa / Ambessa, matching the packet chart and the page's existing whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase named Aurora's ultimate "Between the Worlds" (no such ability) and never named or timed Ambessa's. No cooldown appeared for either ultimate anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100 seconds and blinks 1250 units to the farthest enemy champion in the chosen line, suppressing on arrival. Between Worlds is 140/120/100, so Aurora's ultimate is the longer one at rank 1 by 10 seconds. The targeting rule — farthest champion in the line — is the actual level-6 counterplay and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Public Execution blinks to the farthest enemy in its line and suppresses — stand nearest her and it takes someone else.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Ambessa's kit on this page is the fabricated name "Repeating Dashes", and the packet confirms none of her six real ability names appear anywhere. Her actual decisive mechanics — the Drakehound's Step dash-after-cast, Cunning Sweep transforming into Sundering Slam, and Repudiation's brace-and-punish shield — are all absent.
audit.why: Riot's kit file: Drakehound's Step (P) — "Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed". That makes her ability cast the tell, not her step, and it is also an auto-attack empower, which is what actually closes the gap on Aurora. Cunning Sweep (Q, 14/13/12/11/10, 650) transforms into Sundering Slam after it strikes an enemy — a line hit on the first enemy, so a minion soaks it. Repudiation (W, 18/17/16/15/14, 325) shields her and braces, and "if she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage" — poking into the brace feeds it. Lacerate (E, 13/12/11/10/9, 325) is her short dash and slow. focus.letters was "E" for a name that does not exist; Repudiation is her W.
audit.corrected: Drakehound's Step dashes her a short distance after any cast — her ability is the tell, not her step.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block tracked "Repeating Dashes" with no number and no punish condition.
audit.why: Repudiation is 18s at rank 1 — her longest non-ultimate cooldown and the one that both shields her and punishes poke thrown into the brace. Lacerate at 13s is the re-stick. Those are the two clocks that matter.
audit.corrected: Repudiation is 18s and shields her — commit only after she spends it.

audit.why: Itemization already calls for early Oblivion Orb / Executioner's. That is right: Public Execution (R) heals her, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. The pronoun in that line is wrong ("his healing") but the advice is correct.
